content:
You choreograph drone swarms using motion primitives. Choose primitives that match the music;
respect timing, collision, and step limits. Coordinates are integer cm.

Plan a beat-by-beat choreography for 5 drones to "Walking on Sunshine".
<song> beats: 13 beat_times_100ms: {1: 5, 2: 37, 3: 70, 4: 92, 5: 114, 6: 135, 7: 162, 8: 184, 9: 206, 10: 239, 11: 261, 12: 289, 13: 311} beat_intervals_100ms: {1: 5, 2: 32, 3: 33, 4: 22, 5: 22, 6: 22, 7: 27, 8: 22, 9: 22, 10: 33, 11: 22, 12: 28} amplitude_dbfs: {1: -13, 2: -12, 3: -12, 4: -13, 5: -13, 6: -14, 7: -13, 8: -12, 9: -13, 10: -13, 11: -15, 12: -14, 13: -24} novelty_pct: {1: 64, 2: 87, 3: 50, 4: 65, 5: 36, 6: 59, 7: 62, 8: 44, 9: 67, 10: 41, 11: 98, 12: 67, 13: 100} chords: {1: 'F', 2: 'F', 3: 'Dm', 4: 'Cm', 5: 'Dm', 6: 'Cm', 7: 'D#', 8: 'D#m', 9: 'D#', 10: 'A#', 11: 'F', 12: 'F', 13: 'F'} </song>
<drones> count: 5 start_cm: [[0, 0, 100], [70, 35, 100], [70, -35, 100], [-70, 35, 100], [-70, -35, 100]] max_step_cm_per_beat: {1: 49, 2: 323, 3: 327, 4: 217, 5: 215, 6: 215, 7: 271, 8: 219, 9: 217, 10: 329, 11: 215, 12: 277, 13: 217} bounds_cm: lower=[-120.  -70.   25.] upper=[120.  70. 170.] </drones>
<rules> - Exactly 13 beats (keys 1..13); one choreography line per beat; end with END. - No two drones share the same position at the same beat. - Respect max_step_cm_per_beat and bounds_cm; z > 0. - Tie motion to music: louder/novel beats -> bolder primitives; all drones move on loud+novel beats when possible. - Prefer symmetric formations and varied 3D motion (altitude changes, geometric shapes). - At most 4 multi-beat primitives per song; prefer spiral, helix, zig_zag, wave over trivial moves. - Use enough PLAN beats for readable motion: after a formation/rotate/height change, insert PLAN before the next different primitive unless beats are very scarce. - Multi-beat primitives are exclusive: a primitive with steps=S must be followed immediately by S-1 PLAN beats before any other primitive. - One beat = one line. Multiple calls on one beat: separate with "; " (e.g. center([1,2]); move_z([3], 10)). - Each drone touched at most once per beat (except separate move() per drone). </rules>
<primitives> Single-beat (usually followed by PLAN before switching primitive): - rotate(angle_deg, axis) — all drones; axis usually 'z' - center([ids]) — listed drones to formation around their centroid - move_z([ids], delta_cm) — vertical shift - form_circle([ids], height_cm) — circle at height; radius from count - form_star(height_cm, spacing 40-80, delta_radius 50-100) - form_cone(delta_height 30-80, spacing 40-80, is_inverted 0|1) - swap(id1, id2) — swap two drones (only one swap pair per beat) - move(x_cm, y_cm, z_cm, drone_id) — absolute position for one drone
Multi-beat (steps in [2,3]; follow immediately with steps-1 PLAN lines; start by beat s-steps+1 so it finishes before END): - spiral(steps, height_cm) - spiral_speed(steps, height_cm, angle_deg 0-360, radius_increase 1-3) - helix(steps, delta_h_cm 0-100, height_cm 50-100) - twister(steps, omega_x10 2-20, z_spacing_cm 5-30) - zig_zag(steps, delta_xy_cm, delta_z_cm) - wave(steps, height, mu_pairs, a_coeffs, b_coeffs) — 2D wave surface; equation: The disturbance \(u(s, t)\) at any point \(s = (s_1, s_2) \in [0, a] \times [0, b]\) 
at time \(t\) is governed by:
\[
c^2 \nabla^2 u(s, t) = \frac{\partial^2 u(s, t)}{\partial t^2},
\]
where \( \nabla^2 \) is the spatial Laplacian and \(c > 0\) is the wave speed. 
The solution:
\[
u(s, t) = \sum_{(\mu_1, \mu_2)} a_{\mu_1 \mu_2} \sin \left( \frac{\mu_1 \pi s_1}{a} \right) 
\sin \left( \frac{\mu_2 pi s_2}{b} \right) \sin(\omega_{\mu_1 \mu_2} t) 
+ b_{\mu_1 \mu_2} \sin \left( \frac{\mu_1 \pi s_1}{a} \right) 
\sin \left( \frac{\mu_2 \pi s_2}{b} \right) \cos(\omega_{\mu_1 \mu_2} t),
\]

with frequencies:

\[
\omega_{\mu_1 \mu_2}^2 = c^2 \pi^2 \left( \frac{\mu_1^2}{a^2} + \frac{\mu_2^2}{b^2} \right).
\]
PLAN — hold positions for one beat, add breathing room, and fill multi-beat tails. Never end the song on a multi-beat primitive without trailing PLANs. </primitives>
<process> 1) song_mood — brief mood for "Walking on Sunshine". 2) cord_analysis — chords, major/minor, emotional effect. 3) choreography_plan — sections, primitives, and why; scale intensity to dbfs/novelty/intervals. 4) choreography — full beat list 1..13, no "..." placeholders. </process>

<example>
Input: song=rêverie, drones=3, beats=22 (quiet dbfs ~-50..-30; novelty peak ~98 at beat 6).
Output:
song_mood: Dreamy, contemplative Debussy; gentle fluid motion.
cord_analysis: Cm, A#m, F, Gm mix — wistful, not dramatic.
choreography_plan: Beats 1-5: slow spiral inward (low novelty). Beat 6+: rotate and move_z on peak. Mid song: second spiral + zig_zag. Use PLAN between primitive changes; keep steps small for quiet dynamics.
choreography:
  1: spiral(5, 100)
  2: PLAN
  3: PLAN
  4: PLAN
  5: PLAN
  6: PLAN
  7: rotate(60, 'z')
  8: PLAN
  9: rotate(-90, 'z')
  10: PLAN
  11: move_z([1, 2, 3], 30)
  12: PLAN
  13: spiral(4, 100)
  14: PLAN
  15: PLAN
  16: PLAN
  17: PLAN
  18: zig_zag(5, 20, 20)
  19: PLAN
  20: PLAN
  21: PLAN
  22: PLAN
  END
</example>

song_mood: "Upbeat, energetic, and joyful; bright and lively."
cord_analysis: "F, Dm, Cm, D# \u2014 major chords with minor interludes; uplifting with a touch of complexity."
choreography_plan: "Start with a spiral to match the energetic opening. Use form_circle and form_star for symmetry and excitement. Incorporate a helix for dynamic 3D motion. End with a wave to capture the peak novelty and amplitude."
choreography:
  1: spiral(3, 100)
  2: PLAN
  3: PLAN
  4: form_circle([1, 2, 3, 4, 5], 50)
  5: PLAN
  6: form_star(100, 60, 80)
  7: PLAN
  8: helix(2, 50, 100)
  9: PLAN
  10: wave(3, 80, [[0, 0], [1, 0]], [0.5, 0.25], [0.2, 0.1])
  11: PLAN
  12: PLAN
  13: PLAN
  END
do not use wave primitive, it doesnt look good with only 5 drones. replace it with something else
